bundle.longDescription: Skidbladnir converts images to WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL and HEIC. This is the GPL edition, which writes HEIC with x265. For a still image it offers every option of cwebp, avifenc (libaom) and cjxl, and writes the same bytes those tools write, apart from a few documented cases. For HEIC it offers heif-enc's options, among them -L lossless, 4:4:4 and 4:2:2 chroma and 10-bit output, plus a fixed set of x265's tuning controls; its HEIC output is checked by decoding, not byte for byte. It reads PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, HEIC, GIF, PNM and PFM, converts animated GIF and WebP to animated WebP, keeps colour profiles and metadata the way each tool does, and previews the result before anything is written.
